product.title: Full-Day: Colosseum, Vatican Museums & St Peter's Guided Tour

description.text: With this full-day tour, save time by visiting Rome’s most legendary attractions in one day: the Colosseum and the Vatican. After meeting your guide and group, start your day with a comprehensive tour of the Vatican, visiting the museums, the Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's Basilica. Stops include Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basilica, Colosseum, Palatine Hill, Roman Forum. Then, after a short break for lunch (own expense), tour the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Roman Forum. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basilica, Colosseum that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
